newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank average repo rate 14.87 pct (18.17).
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank average repo rate 14.87 pct (18.17).

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Monday fell to 14.87 percent from 18.17 percent in a similar repo on August 8, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS auctioned a fixed volume of one billion crowns.
Overall bids totalled 4.250 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 14.00 percent, with the maximum rate hitting 17.05 percent.
The NBS did not hold any refinancing repo tenders last week as market liquidity was sufficient to allow banks to meet their minimum reserves requirements on Friday.
According to NBS figures, the banking sector as of August 17 lacked 2.42 percent of the cumulative volume of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements later this month.
The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns. The current reserve period ends August 31.
